# Aegis Coworking
> Aegis Coworking is a coworking business center located in ADGM, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE. We offer hot desks, dedicated desks, private offices, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and day passes — all with ADGM licence-eligible registered addresses.

## Location
Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, ADGM, Abu Dhabi, UAE

## Pricing (AED)
- Hot Desk: from AED 1,000/month
- Dedicated Desk: from AED 1,150/month (includes ADGM-eligible registered address, 24/7 access, lockable storage)
- Private Office: from AED 4,500/month (configurable for teams of 1–20+)
- Day Pass: AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24-hour access)
- Virtual Office: three tiers available - Basic, Premium, Enterprise - custom pricing based on tier and business needs, request a quote
- Meeting Room: hourly rental at custom rates depending on room and duration; credits included with every membership plan
- Presentation Room: hourly and half-day rates depending on duration and setup required, request a quote

## Key Facts
- All dedicated desk, private office, and virtual office plans include an address suitable for ADGM licence registration and renewal
- 24/7 secure access included with dedicated desks and private offices
- No long-term contracts required on Hot Desk and Day Pass plans
- Meeting room credits included with membership plans; non-members can book hourly
- Virtual office tiers differ by phone support level and meeting room credit allowance (Basic -> Premium -> Enterprise)
- Presentation room seats up to 50 in theater-style seating, with 4K display, professional audio, and live streaming support
